titles.title: To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to designate the Department of Homeland Security as the Sector Risk Management Agency for the information technology sector, require the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to carry out the responsibilities of the Department for such sector, strengthen public and private sector engagement to reduce cybersecurity risks to such sector and secure its systems, assets, and key resources against cybersecurity threats, supply chain compromise, and physical threats, including terrorism threats to the United States, and for other purposes.

To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to designate the Department of Homeland Security as the Sector Risk Management Agency for the information technology sector, require the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to carry out the responsibilities of the Department for such sector, strengthen public and private sector engagement to reduce cybersecurity risks to such sector and secure its systems, assets, and key resources against cybersecurity threats, supply chain compromise, and physical threats, including terrorism threats to the United States, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Homeland Security.
